caption: 🍤🥔 Toddler-Friendly Shrimp & Potato Bites! So easy, soft, and yummy for the whole family! These little bites are perfect for toddlers and a great way to use up that one potato sitting in your kitchen! 🤭 Ingredients: * 1 medium potato, peeled & grated * 4–5 shrimp, peeled & finely chopped * 4 tbsp all-purpose flour * Garlic powder & onion powder, to taste * Sprinkle of dried parsley flakes * Pinch of salt * Splash of water * Olive oil for cooking Instructions: 1. Peel and grate your potato using the largest holes on your grater. 2. Lightly salt and let sit for 3–5 minutes, then squeeze out as much water as possible. 💡 The potato may turn slightly orange due to oxidation, so try to cook it shortly after grating! 3. Finely chop the shrimp into small, toddler-friendly pieces. 4. Combine the grated potato, shrimp, flour, garlic powder, onion powder, and parsley. 5. Add a splash of water and mix until there’s no dry flour left. The mixture should be slightly wet but still hold together. 6. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Scoop small portions into the pan and gently flatten into little bites. 7. Cook both sides until golden brown and the potato is tender and shrimp is fully cooked through (145°F for shrimp). ✨ These come out soft and delicious, making them easy for little ones to enjoy! And we all know toddlers LOVE to dip, so serve these with a little ketchup! 🍅❤️ Let cool before serving, and cut into age-appropriate pieces. Save this recipe and give it a try next time you have an extra potato lying around! 🥔💛 #easyrecipe #toddlerrecipes #toddlermealideas #toddlerlunch #toddlerfood
